glossary.name: ecommerce-glossary
glossary.display_name: LumièreShop Executive Retail Glossary (140 Tables Complete)
glossary.description: Enterprise semantic glossary defining retail business metrics, e-commerce KPIs, operational failure modes, and BigQuery column bindings across all 17 domains for LumièreShop.

categories.description: Paid social, search, influencer marketing, ad algorithms, and conversion metrics.
Inventory levels, stockouts, warehouse physical hubs, and batch replenishments.
Carrier performance, lead-time SLAs, regional delivery promises, and cart abandonment.
Competitor price scrapes, promotional discounts, and catalog recommendation systems.
Payment service providers (PSP), gateway error codes, and consent management tracking.
Gross revenue, financial pacing, commercial target variance, and margin calculations.
Product return authorizations, inspection triage, refund processing, and return rates.
Helpdesk ticketing, first contact resolution, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and NPS.
Loyalty tier memberships, points ledger, rewards redemption, and gift card balances.
Physical store registers, in-person transactions, click & collect (BOPIS), and store inventory.
Product master taxonomy, localized translations, size charts, and attribute completeness.
Email deliverability, template conversions, bounce tracking, affiliate publisher commissions, and coupon promotions.
Staging pipelines and raw API feeds from Shopify, Meta, Google Ads, Stripe, Adyen, Zendesk, SAP ERP, and GA4.
Agent interaction logs, query execution telemetry, data profiling scans, and table access auditing.

terms.definition: Marketing efficiency metric calculated as total attributed sales revenue divided by advertising expenditure across paid acquisition channels.
The average financial amount billed by the advertising network for each user click interaction.
The percentage of web sessions or product page visitors that successfully finalize a completed transaction.
Algorithmic state in Meta Ads/Google Ads where an ad set fails to exit the initial machine learning phase or becomes restricted due to creative fatigue or low conversion volume.
Automated bidding reaction where the ad platform slashes daily budget allocations when observed conversion rate drops below the required threshold to maintain efficiency.
Gross merchandise value generated directly through creator promotion codes (e.g. TikTok, Instagram).
State when physical inventory quantity for an active product at a distribution center drops to zero or below.
Calculated monetary loss incurred when high-intent shoppers attempt to purchase an out-of-stock SKU.
Minimum threshold buffer quantity maintained in warehouse to prevent unexpected stockouts during demand surges.
Central European commercial zone comprising Germany (DE), Austria (AT), and Switzerland (CH), primarily fulfilled by the Frankfurt Hub (DC 2).
The promised carrier transit duration displayed to customers at checkout. Standard target is 24 hours.
Operational workload percentage of logistics distribution centers and freight carriers. Utilization over 90% triggers shipping SLA delays.
Ratio of competitor retail prices compared to LumièreShop prices for identical SKUs. 1.00x denotes exact price parity.
Algorithmic failure mode where the product recommendation engine displays unrelated categories (e.g. Electronics on Beauty pages) upon fallback.
Technical transaction failures, gateway timeouts, or authorization declines returned by Stripe, PayPal, or Adyen.

The annual Q4 retail peak promotional sales period from Monday November 23, 2026 00:00:00 to Sunday November 29, 2026 23:59:59 UTC, encompassing Black Friday and Cyber Monday. The proportion of total e-commerce revenue retained after subtracting product acquisition and manufacturing costs of goods sold (COGS).
Corporate financial liquidity metric measuring the average number of calendar days required to collect invoice receivables from corporate clients.

In LumièreShop operations, 'this week' (or 'current week') refers to Black Week 2026 (the promotional week starting Monday, November 23, 2026 through Monday, November 30, 2026 / Cyber Monday). For actual transactions, inventory, and marketing events, records are available from Monday, November 23, 2026 00:00:00 UTC up to the latest reporting cutoff of Friday, November 27, 2026 14:30:00 UTC. Planned target pacing tables cover the entire 8-day promotional week (November 23–30, 2026).

In LumièreShop operations, 'today' refers to Black Friday (Friday, November 27, 2026) from 00:00:00 UTC up to the reporting cutoff at 14:30:00 UTC. SQL queries filtering for 'today' or 'today's sales' must filter for date '2026-11-27' or timestamp range between '2026-11-27 00:00:00 UTC' and '2026-11-27 14:30:00 UTC'.

In the LumièreShop simulation, 'yesterday' refers to the full calendar day preceding Black Friday, which is Thursday, November 26, 2026 (Thanksgiving / Black Thursday). SQL queries filtering for 'yesterday' must filter for DATE = '2026-11-26' or timestamp between '2026-11-26 00:00:00 UTC' and '2026-11-26 23:59:59 UTC'.

In the LumièreShop simulation, 'previous week' (or 'last week') refers to the full 7-day pre-promotional baseline week immediately preceding Black Week, spanning Monday, November 16, 2026 through Sunday, November 22, 2026. SQL queries comparing current performance against last week must use this date range.
In the LumièreShop simulation, 'two weeks ago' refers to the 7-day baseline period spanning Monday, November 9, 2026 through Sunday, November 15, 2026.

In the LumièreShop simulation, 'this month' refers to November 2026 Month-to-Date (MTD), spanning from November 1, 2026 00:00:00 UTC up to the simulation cutoff on Friday, November 27, 2026 14:30:00 UTC.
In the LumièreShop simulation, 'last month' (or 'previous month') refers to October 2026, containing historical baseline data in the dataset (October 11, 2026 through October 31, 2026).

terms.display_name: Current Time / Black Friday Cutoff (2026-11-27 14:30 UTC)
terms.definition: The operational reporting cutoff timestamp for LumièreShop: Friday, November 27, 2026 at 14:30:00 UTC (Black Friday early afternoon). Represents the latest available real-time operational and transactional data point in the data warehouse.
The final day of the 8-day Black Week promotional campaign, taking place on Monday, November 30, 2026. Commercial targets and promotional schedules are planned through this date.
The opening day of Black Week 2026 on Monday, November 23, 2026 (Day 1 of promotional campaign).

Tuesday, November 24, 2026 of Black Week (Day 2 of the promotional campaign calendar). Used to evaluate second-day promotional intake, category conversion rates, and inventory velocity across regional distribution centers.

Wednesday, November 25, 2026 of Black Week (Day 3 of the promotional campaign calendar). Used to evaluate mid-week promotional sales velocity, customer basket composition, and recommender engagement across digital storefronts.

Thursday, November 26, 2026 of Black Week (Day 4 of the promotional campaign calendar, corresponding to Thanksgiving / Black Thursday). Used to evaluate pre-Black Friday customer traffic surge, advertising campaign pacing, and promotional intake.

The 6-week historical baseline period in ecommerce_dw spanning October 11, 2026 to November 22, 2026, capturing steady-state operations, seasonal trends, and baseline run-rates prior to Black Week promotional surge.

The fourth financial and operational quarter of 2026 (Q4), spanning October 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 (with historical and Black Week actuals recorded up to Friday, November 27, 2026 14:30:00 UTC).
15-minute granular pacing intervals on Black Friday (96 intervals per day), from 00:00 UTC up to 14:30 UTC for actuals, and full day for planned targets.
